overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）。方法上以时间序列、协整分析为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（7 篇）、arXiv（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Income, health, and spurious cointegration
papers.venue: The European Journal of Health Economics
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Data for many nations show a long-run increase, over many decades, of income, indexed by gross domestic product (GDP) per capita, and population health, indexed by mortality or life expectancy at birth (LEB). However, the short-run and long-run relationships between these variables have been interpreted in different ways, and many controversies remain open. It has been claimed that population health and income are cointegrated, and that this demonstrates a positive long-run effect of income on population health. We show, however, that a statistical fnding of cointegration between an indicator of population health and GDP per capita is not a sound method for inferring a causal link. For a given country, it is easy to find computer-generated data or time series of real observations, related or unrelated to the country, that according to standard methods, are also cointegrated with the country’s LEB or mortality. More generally, given a trending time series, it is easy to find other series, observational or artificial, that appear cointegrated with it. Thus, standard cointegration methodology, that is relatively common in empirical investigations, often leads to establishing cointegration between series which are spuriously, not causally related.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
多项国家的数据表明，在数十年间，人均国内生产总值（GDP）代表的人均收入以及出生时的死亡率或预期寿命（LEB）代表的人口健康状况均呈现出长期增长趋势。然而，这些变量之间的短期与长期关系存在不同的解读方式，许多争议仍未得到解决。有人认为人口健康与收入之间存在共整关系，从而证明收入对人口健康具有积极的长期影响。然而，我们的研究表明，仅凭统计上发现人口健康指标与人均GDP之间存在共整关系，并不足以推断出两者之间的因果关系。对于任何一个国家而言，都很容易找到计算机生成的数据或实际观测数据序列（无论这些数据与该国家是否相关），根据标准方法判断，这些数据同样与该国家的预期寿命或死亡率存在共整关系。更一般地说，对于任何具有趋势性的时间序列，都很容易找到其他（无论是真实的还是人为构造的）序列，使其看起来与该序列存在共整关系。因此，在实证研究中较为常用的标准共整方法往往会导致将本质上并无因果关系的序列误认为是共整的。。研究方法：时间序列、协整分析。

papers.title: KD4MT: A Survey of Knowledge Distillation for Machine Translation
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Knowledge Distillation (KD) as a research area has gained a considerable traction in recent years as a compression tool to address challenges related to ever-larger models in NLP. Remarkably, Machine Translation (MT) offers a much more nuanced take on this narrative: in MT, KD also functions as a general-purpose knowledge transfer mechanism that shapes supervision and translation quality as well as efficiency.
                  This survey synthesizes KD for MT (KD4MT) across 105 papers. We begin by introducing both MT and KD for non-experts, followed by an overview of the standard KD approaches relevant to MT applications. Subsequently, we categorize advances in the KD4MT literature based on (i) their methodological contributions and (ii) their practical applications. Our qualitative and quantitative analyses identify common trends in the field and highlight key research gaps as well as the absence of unified evaluation practice for KD methods in MT. We further provide practical guidelines for selecting a KD method in concrete settings and highlight potential risks associated with the application of KD to MT such as increased hallucination and bias amplification. Finally, we discuss the role of LLMs in re-shaping the KD4MT field. To support further research, we complement our survey with a publicly available database summarizing the main characteristics of the surveyed KD methods and a glossary of key terms.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
近年来，知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation, KD）作为一种压缩技术，在应对自然语言处理（NLP）领域中日益庞大的模型所带来的挑战方面取得了显著进展。值得注意的是，机器翻译（Machine Translation, MT）为这一研究方向提供了更为深入的视角：在MT中，KD不仅作为一种通用的知识转移机制，还影响着监督过程、翻译质量以及翻译效率。  
本研究综合分析了105篇关于MT领域知识蒸馏（KD4MT）的学术论文。首先，我们为非专业人士介绍了MT和KD的基本概念，随后概述了与MT应用相关的标准KD方法。接着，我们根据方法论贡献和实践应用两个方面对KD4MT领域的进展进行了分类。通过定性和定量分析，我们发现了该领域的共同趋势，并指出了关键的研究空白，同时指出MT中KD方法缺乏统一的评估标准。此外，我们还提供了在实际应用中选择KD方法的具体指导原则，并强调了将KD应用于MT可能带来的风险，如幻觉现象的增加和偏见放大。最后，我们探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在重塑KD4MT领域中的作用。为了推动后续研究，我们建立了一个公开可用的数据库，汇总了所分析KD方...。研究方法：自然语言处理、调查数据。

papers.title: Equity and Aggregate Ambiguity
papers.abstract: Equitable resource allocations in the context of symmetric risk exposures are intuitively desirable and sometimes even expected in public planning. However, public planners generally are also concerned with mitigating risk and, more generally, uncertainty and ambiguity. We study a fundamental conflict between equity and ambiguity avoidance in public risk allocation problems. Our main results are framed and established in the setting of general symmetric aggregate losses equipped with dependence uncertainty among individual losses. Specializing to the classical model of Keeney (1980), we prove that an increase in equity is equivalent to an increase in aggregate ambiguity. We then provide a quantitative characterization of equity and ambiguity avoidance through the $α$-maxmin preference framework, establishing conditions on ambiguity and risk attitudes under which each criterion holds. Specifically, equity corresponds to ambiguity or risk proneness, while ambiguity avoidance corresponds to ambiguity or risk aversion. The analysis extends to general classes of symmetric aggregation functions, where we show that ambiguity attitude is the primary determinant of preference, though aggregation structure and risk attitude also play important roles. Numerical illustrations validate our theoretical findings and explore the equity-ambiguity tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在对称风险暴露的背景下，公平的资源分配在直觉上是非常可取的，有时甚至也是公共规划所期望的。然而，公共规划者通常还关注风险缓解，以及更广泛的不确定性与模糊性的降低。我们研究了公共风险分配问题中公平性与模糊性规避之间的根本冲突。我们的主要研究结果是在具有个体损失之间依赖性不确定性的对称总损失框架下提出的。以Keeney（1980）的经典模型为例，我们证明了公平性的提高等同于总模糊性的增加。随后，我们通过$α$-maxmin偏好框架对公平性与模糊性规避进行了定量描述，明确了在何种模糊性和风险态度条件下这两种标准分别成立。具体而言，公平性对应于对模糊性或风险的偏好，而模糊性规避则对应于对模糊性或风险的厌恶。这一分析扩展到了各类对称聚合函数，结果表明模糊性态度是偏好决策的主要决定因素，尽管聚合结构和风险态度也同样重要。数值实例验证了我们的理论发现，并探讨了公平性与模糊性之间的权衡关系。。

papers.title: Stablecoin Runs as Safe-Asset Stress Signals: Episode-Level Evidence for Central Bank Surveillance
papers.abstract: This paper asks whether stablecoin runs carry information about U.S. Treasury yields. Using daily data on USDT, USDC and BUSD from 2021 to 2025 and five stress episodes, it measures flows from changes in token units rather than market capitalisation, which removes the phantom inflows the standard measure records when tokens lose their peg. Flows have no stable relationship with yields in normal periods. During the three panic-driven runs, a one-billion-dollar five-day redemption is associated with an 8.5 basis point fall in the three-month bill yield within ten trading days, while two regulatory episodes carry no such signal. The response is broad across maturities and has the opposite sign to what reserve liquidation predicts, which points to flight to quality. The effect is led by the TerraUSD collapse and corroborated by the USDC/SVB run. Five-day redemptions of roughly USD 2 to 3 billion during a panic mark the scale at which stablecoin stress becomes informative for surveillance.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文探讨了稳定币的赎回行为是否能够反映美国国债收益率的变化。研究使用了2021年至2025年间USDT、USDC和BUSD的日度数据，以及五次市场压力事件，通过分析token单位数量的变化（而非市场资本规模）来衡量资金流动情况。这种分析方法能够排除当稳定币失去与法定货币的挂钩关系时标准指标所记录的虚假资金流入现象。在正常时期，资金流动与国债收益率之间并无显著关联。在三次由恐慌引发的赎回事件中，每次10亿美元的五天赎回行为会导致三个月期国债收益率在十个工作日内下降8.5个基点；而两次监管事件并未引发类似的市场反应。这种效应在各种国债到期期限上均普遍存在，且其方向与储备金清算所预测的结果相反，这表明投资者更倾向于选择高质量的投资品种。该现象主要由TerraUSD的崩溃引发，并得到了USDC/SVB赎回事件的进一步验证。在恐慌期间，如果五天内的赎回金额达到约20亿至30亿美元，那么稳定币市场的压力就足以对监管机构提供有价值的信息。。

papers.title: Executive Pay Ceilings, Corporate Risk‐Taking and Strategic Rebalancing
papers.abstract: Employing the 2014 mandatory pay ceiling regulation for top executives in Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) as a quasi‐natural experiment, this paper adopts a difference‐in‐differences (DiD) approach and finds that the regulation significantly reduces corporate risk‐taking among SOEs. The reduction is more pronounced under greater policy uncertainty, among firms led by younger chairpersons, and when executives experience larger pay cuts. The decline does not reflect a broad contraction in investment. Acquisition frequency and transaction value fall significantly, whereas R&D and capital expenditures remain largely unchanged. At the same time, treated SOEs increase CSR performance, CSR disclosure and employment growth. Textual analysis of Management's Discussion and Analysis disclosures reveals a corresponding reorientation of managerial attention, with greater attention to political objectives and less attention to economic objectives. Relative political orientation also becomes more positively associated with subsequent political promotion after the reform. Overall, our findings suggest that pay ceilings reweight executives' economic and political career incentives, leading them to rebalance strategic priorities rather than simply reduce managerial activity.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文以2014年中国国有企业（SOEs）针对高管实施的强制性薪酬上限规定为准自然实验，采用差异-in-differences（DiD）方法进行研究，发现该规定显著降低了国有企业的风险承担行为。在政策不确定性较高、企业董事长年龄较年轻，以及高管薪酬削减幅度较大的情况下，这种降低效应更为明显。这一变化并未导致企业整体投资活动的收缩：企业的收购频率和交易金额显著下降，而研发支出和资本支出基本保持不变。与此同时，接受该规定的国有企业提升了企业社会责任（CSR）表现、增强了CSR信息披露，并促进了就业增长。通过对企业管理层讨论与分析（Management’s Discussion and Analysis）相关内容的文本分析，发现企业管理层的关注重点发生了相应转变，更加重视政治目标而非经济目标。此外，企业在改革后的政治导向与后续的政治晋升表现呈正相关关系。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，薪酬上限规定重新平衡了高管的经济和政治职业激励，促使他们重新调整战略优先级，而不仅仅是减少了管理活动。。研究方法：自然实验、实验方法。

papers.title: When Formalization Costs More Than It Pays: Threshold Accrual and the Actuarial Price of Extending Pension Coverage in Morocco
papers.venue: International Review of Applied Finance, Economics and Management
papers.abstract: Bringing informal wage earners into contributory pension schemes is commonly expected both to protect workers and to consolidate pay-as-you-go finances. This article examines the second expectation for the long-term branch of Morocco’s National Social Security Fund (CNSS). The branch pays 50% of the reference wage after 3,240 declared days and, since Law 02-24 of 2025, a proportional pension from 1,320 days. We derive the return implied by the legal accrual formula and simulate formalization scenarios with a deterministic cohort actuarial model (base year 2024, horizon 2070) calibrated on the branch’s 2020–2024 accounts. A dirham of wage-indexed contributions purchases an annual pension of 40.5% between 1,320 and 3,240 days and 19.6% after thirty years, between 4.3 and 8.9 times a self-financing benchmark of 4.6%. Raising the contributing share of private wage employees by one point a year postpones reserve exhaustion from 2036 to 2038 but deepens the 2070 technical deficit from 0.94% to 1.14% of GDP; across six assumed entrant profiles, newly declared workers fund at most 42% of the rights they accumulate by 2070. Under a self-financing linear accrual rule, the long-run effect becomes slightly positive. Lowering the density on which rights accrue from 293 to 222 days leaves finances almost unchanged but moves 7 to 15 points of a full-career cohort from the full-rate to the reduced pension. Formalization exposes, rather than creates, an accrual mispricing; it should be accompanied by prospective accrual reform and explicit, budgeted support for low earners.
papers.summary_zh: 【保险与养老】将非正规工资劳动者纳入缴费型养老金计划，通常被认为既能保护劳动者权益，又能巩固现收现付的养老金财务体系。本文重点探讨了这一举措对摩洛哥国家社会保障基金（CNSS）长期财务状况的潜在影响。根据现行规定，该基金在劳动者累计工作满3,240天后开始支付相当于参考工资50%的养老金；自2025年第02-24号法律实施以来，工作满1,320天即开始按比例发放养老金。我们通过法律规定的养老金计算公式推算出相应的投资回报，并利用确定性群体精算模型（基准年为2024年，预测期限为2070年）对相关情景进行了模拟。结果显示：在劳动者工作满1,320至3,240天期间，每缴纳一迪拉姆的工资指数化保费可换取40.5%的年养老金；工作满30年后，这一比例降至19.6%，仅为自给自足基准水平的4.6%的4.3至8.9倍。若每年将私营企业工资劳动者的缴费比例提高1个百分点，基金储备的耗尽时间将从2036年推迟至2038年，但2070年的技术性赤字将从GDP的0.94%上升至1.14%；在六种不同的假设情景下，新加入养老金计划的劳动者到2070年最多只能为其累积的养老金权益提供42%的资金支持。在采用自给自足...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Model choice and prompt framing in LLM sustainability judgments
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for sustainability assessment and decision support, yet their judgments may depend on the selected model and on how the task is defined. We compare 13 locally executed open-weight LLMs on 80 author-written sustainability scenarios using three prompt families that ask which actor should be responsible, bear the costs, or initiate action. Each model answered at two temperature settings with 100 repetitions, producing 624,000 deposited outputs, of which 610,708 contain a complete score vector. Scores were analyzed as relative actor support after removing each response’s overall level. Within this instrument, the cost prompt family produced the highest cross-model disagreement, exceeding both responsibility and catalyst by 7.37 points (question-cluster 95% intervals 5.56−9.15 and 5.38−9.36, describing variation across these 80 scenarios). It also produced the most lead-actor disagreement and the lowest full consensus. Moving from catalyst to cost reduced relative support for government and increased it for individuals and firms; moving from cost to responsibility largely reversed this pattern. These differences exceeded temperature-setting differences and persisted under model exclusion, alternative score transformations and tie rules, missing-response checks, and stems without explicit cost wording. Exploratory category patterns are conditional on uneven item coverage. Secondary rationale-language comparisons show the same within-model ordering but not the most cross-model variation under cost. Operational use should disclose model, prompt, and temperature choices; compare plausible alternatives; repeat generations; and refer high-disagreement judgments for human deliberation.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】摘要  
大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于可持续性评估和决策支持，但其判断结果可能取决于所选模型以及任务的定义方式。我们对比了13个在本地运行的开放权重LLMs，这些模型针对80个由作者编写的可持续性场景进行了分析，使用了三种不同的提示类型来询问应由哪个主体负责、承担成本或采取行动。每个模型在两种不同的温度设置下进行了100次回答，共生成了624,000条输出结果，其中610,708条包含完整的评分向量。在去除每个回答的总体评分后，我们对评分结果进行了分析，以评估各主体之间的相对支持度。在这些提示类型中，“成本”提示类型导致的模型间分歧最大，其分歧程度超过了“责任”和“催化剂”提示类型7.37个百分点（问题簇的95%置信区间分别为5.56–9.15和5.38–9.36，反映了这80个场景中的变化情况）。该提示类型还导致了最多的主体间分歧，并且使得模型间的共识度最低。从“催化剂”提示类型转换为“成本”提示类型会降低对政府的相对支持度，同时提高对个人和企业的支持度；而从“成本”提示类型转换为“责任”提示类型则基本逆转了这一趋势。这些差异超出了温度设置带来的影响，并且在排除特定...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Instrumental convergence and power seeking
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Recent years have seen increasing concern that artificial intelligence may soon pose an existential risk to humanity. One leading ground for concern is that artificial agents may be power-seeking, aiming to acquire power and in the process disempowering humanity. I show how the argument from power-seeking rests on a strong version of a claim known as the instrumental convergence thesis. I explore leading defenses of the instrumental convergence thesis and argue that none establishes the thesis in a strong enough form to ground the argument from power-seeking. I discuss implications for longtermism, the governance of artificial intelligence, and the methodology of studying risks posed by artificial agents.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】摘要  
近年来，人们越来越担忧人工智能可能很快会对人类构成生存威胁。其中一个主要的担忧是，人工智能实体可能会追求权力，试图获取控制权，并在此过程中剥夺人类的自主权。本文指出，这种担忧的依据源于一种被称为“工具性趋同论”（instrumental convergence thesis）的论点。作者分析了对该论点的主要辩护观点，并认为这些辩护都未能以足够有力的形式证明该论点的正确性，从而无法为“人工智能追求权力”的观点提供充分支持。文章还探讨了这一论点对长期主义（long-termism）、人工智能治理以及研究人工智能所带来风险的方法论的影响。。

papers.title: Axiological Problems of Artificial Intelligence in Education: Between Technological Efficiency and the Humanization of Learning
papers.venue: Urwatul Wutsqo Jurnal Studi Kependidikan dan Keislaman
papers.abstract: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in education offers opportunities to improve efficiency, personalize learning, and support educational activities. However, these benefits raise an axiological question concerning the extent to which technological efficiency contributes to meaningful learning and human development. This article examines the axiological problems associated with the use of AI in education, particularly the tension between technological efficiency and the humanization of learning. Using a literature review approach, this study synthesizes scholarly literature to examine educational values, pedagogical implications, and ethical considerations in AI integration. Through thematic comparison, the synthesis identifies recurring issues and conceptual relationships among the instrumental benefits of AI, student agency, pedagogical relationships, and ethical responsibilities in its use. These relationships are integrated into a conceptual framework comprising four interconnected dimensions: instrumental value, student agency, pedagogical relationships, and ethical-contextual responsibility. The framework emphasizes that the educational value of AI cannot be determined solely by efficiency or the automation of learning activities, but should be assessed in terms of students’ independent thinking, the quality of pedagogical interactions, and ethical principles and contextual needs. This study offers an axiological perspective that connects these four dimensions to evaluate AI adoption in education, positioning technological efficiency as one consideration rather than the sole criterion of educational value. Since the proposed framework is developed through a conceptual synthesis of literature, further research is needed to examine its applicability across different educational contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）在教育领域的应用日益广泛，这为提高教学效率、实现个性化学习以及支持教育活动提供了契机。然而，这些好处也引发了一个价值论问题：即技术效率在多大程度上能够促进有意义的学习和人类的全面发展。本文探讨了AI在教育应用中涉及的价值论问题，尤其是技术效率与学习人性化之间的矛盾。通过文献综述的方法，本研究整合了相关学术成果，分析了AI整合过程中的教育价值、教学意义及伦理考量。通过主题比较，研究揭示了AI的实用价值、学生主体性、教学关系以及伦理责任之间的内在联系，并将这些要素纳入了一个由四个相互关联的维度构成的概念框架中：实用价值、学生主体性、教学关系以及伦理-情境责任。该框架强调，AI的教育价值不能仅通过效率或学习活动的自动化程度来评判，而应从学生的独立思考能力、教学互动的质量以及伦理原则和情境需求等方面进行综合评估。本文提供了一种价值论视角，将这四个维度结合起来评估AI在教育中的应用，将技术效率视为教育价值的考量因素之一，而非唯一标准。由于该框架是基于文献的综合分析构建的，因此还需要进一步的研究来验证其在不同教育情境下的适用性。。

papers.title: Controlling Local Charges: The Tax and Fee Boundary After the Collapse of Executive Review
papers.venue: Journal of Law Public Policy and Public Finance
papers.abstract: Local governments levy charges as well as taxes, and the line between the two determines which legal guarantees apply to a citizen who must pay. This study examines how that line is drawn and how the proliferation of local charges is controlled, in a system where the principal control mechanism was removed by constitutional ruling and later replaced by a different one. The method combines doctrinal analysis with a structured review of research published between 2017 and 2024 and comparative material from Poland, Serbia, South Africa and the United States. Three findings follow. The control architecture has been rebuilt rather than repaired: a 2017 constitutional ruling invalidated executive review of subnational regulations, holding that review belongs to the courts, and the 2022 fiscal relations statute then substituted ex ante restriction of what may be charged for the ex post annulment that had been removed. The forum that inherited the function reviews subnational law poorly, with decisions found seriously flawed and politically sensitive cases avoided. And the doctrinal question of when a charge is in substance a tax is largely unaddressed in recent scholarship; Polish administrative-court jurisprudence on whether general tax law applies to enumerated local charges is the closest available treatment. The study argues that ex ante closure and ex post review answer different questions, and specifies four criteria a charge should satisfy.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】地方政府既征收税费，也收取其他类型的费用；这两者之间的界限决定了公民在支付这些费用时应适用哪些法律保障。本研究探讨了这一界限的划定方式，以及如何在一种主要控制机制被宪法裁决废除、随后又被另一种机制取代的制度下，控制地方性收费的泛滥现象。研究方法结合了理论分析，以及对2017年至2024年间发表的相关研究的系统梳理，并参考了来自波兰、塞尔维亚、南非和美国的案例资料。研究得出以下三点结论：  

1. 对地方性收费的控制机制实际上是被彻底重构而非简单修复的：2017年的一项宪法裁决取消了行政部门对地方性法规的审查权，规定此类审查权应属于法院；2022年的财政关系法规则用事前限制收费项目的方式，取代了此前被废除的事后审查制度。  
2. 承担这一审查职能的机构对地方性法规的审查工作存在严重缺陷，常常回避那些具有政治敏感性的案件。  
3. 关于某种收费在本质上是否属于税款的理论问题，在近期学术研究中基本未被深入探讨；波兰行政法院关于一般税法是否适用于特定地方性收费的判例，是目前最接近这一问题的研究成果。  

研究认为，事前限制与事后审查分别针对不同的问题，并提出了费用应满足的四个标准。。

papers.title: From Account Management To Risk-Triggered Audit: A Continuous Monitoring Framework For Large Taxpayers In E-Invoicing Environments
papers.venue: International Journal of Business & Management Studies
papers.abstract:
This study develops SIGNAL (Sources, Indicators, Graduated response, Narrowed scope, Audit trail, Learning loop), a framework that converts the continuous monitoring of large taxpayers by an assigned account manager into risk-triggered audit selection in jurisdictions that have adopted electronic invoicing. It addresses a paradox observable in Ukraine and increasingly relevant to countries implementing mandatory e-invoicing: tax administrations now receive transaction-level data in near real time, yet the decision to audit a large taxpayer is still driven largely by annual plans, while the richest structured accounting data are requested only after an audit has begun.

Methods. A design-science approach was combined with documentary analysis, structured practitioner reflection and simulation. Phase one analysed a corpus of twenty-eight Ukrainian legal instruments, oversight reports, official publications, foreign regime documents and international guidance covering 2015–2026, together with five foreign e-invoicing and reporting regimes. Phase two constructed the framework, drawing on the author’s practice as the assigned account manager for about ten large taxpayers in the Large Taxpayers Office of the State Tax Service of Ukraine and subsequent work in tax debt collection and in an anti-corruption unit. Phase three evaluated alternative trigger rules through a Monte Carlo simulation of a synthetic portfolio of 1,000 large taxpayers observed over 24 months, with sensitivity analysis across six scenarios.

Scientific novelty. The study identifies a gate–insight gap: in Ukraine, e-invoice data are used intensively at the gate, to suspend the registration of individual invoices (7.7 million invoices carrying UAH 144.1 billion of VAT were suspended in 2021 – H1 2024, while 49.4% of complaints against regional suspension decisions were upheld), but only weakly for insight, that is, for the selection and scoping of audits. Since 1 January 2026 the standard audit file SAF-T UA has been requested from large taxpayers only during a documentary audit. In the simulation, a trigger that requires a weighted signal score to persist for two consecutive months raised the precision of audit selection from 10.0% for a single-signal rule to 90.5%, while retaining 99.7% of non-compliant taxpayers, at the cost of a mean detection delay of about three months; the advantage held, with reduced magnitude, under correlated signals, gradual onset of non-compliance and lower prevalence.

Contributions. The study extends the compliance risk management literature by specifying how monitoring signals should be converted into audit decisions, rather than assuming that better data automatically produce better selection, and links that literature to research on continuous auditing, where alert overload is a recognised failure mode. It contributes to the literature on corruption in tax administration by showing that a formal signal log reduces the discretion of the account manager, the officer with the longest and closest relationship with a large taxpayer.

For countries introducing mandatory e-invoicing, including Poland since February 2026 and the European Union under the VAT in the Digital Age package, the study offers transferable design rules for linking real-time data to proportionate, documented enforcement. It is, to the author’s knowledge, the first framework that treats the account manager’s monitoring and the audit selection decision as a single, auditable process rather than as separate administrative functions.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】本研究提出了SIGNAL（Sources、Indicators、Graduated response、Narrowed scope、Audit trail、Learning loop）框架，该框架将指定账户经理对大型纳税人的持续监控转化为在采用电子发票制度的司法管辖区中基于风险触发的审计选择。这一框架旨在解决乌克兰所观察到的一个悖论现象，这一现象在实施强制性电子发票制度的国家中日益凸显：税务机关现在几乎可以实时获取交易级数据，但针对大型纳税人的审计决策仍主要基于年度计划；而最详细的会计数据往往只有在审计开始后才会被要求提供。

**研究方法**：本研究结合了设计科学方法、文献分析、从业者访谈以及模拟实验。第一阶段分析了2015至2026年间乌克兰的28项法律文件、监督报告、官方出版物、外国制度文件及国际指导准则，同时研究了五种外国的电子发票和报告制度。第二阶段基于作者在乌克兰国家税务局大型纳税人办公室担任指定账户经理的经验，以及随后在税务债务催收和反腐败部门的工作经验，构建了该框架。第三阶段通过模拟1000家大型纳税人在24个月内的行为，评估了不同的风险触发规则，并对六种情景进行...。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Globally promoting legumes by production or use subsidies
papers.abstract: Despite consensus on the positive economic, environmental, and health effects of expanding legume production and consumption, the share of cropland devoted to them remains relatively small, and their share of human consumption is negligible compared with other protein sources such as meat. The presence of externalities associated with legume production and consumption gives room for policy interventions. In this context, we estimate the effects of global subsidies on legume production and consumption using CGEBox, an open-source and open-access Computable General Equilibrium modelling platform, with integrated accounting for land use, land cover, and energy, and considering agricultural and non-agricultural households. The analysis offers high agri-food detail and a special focus on Ghana and Germany, two countries with different agroecological and socioeconomic conditions facing multiple food system issues. Compared to production subsidies, we find that use subsidies are more effective at reducing consumer prices of legumes and stimulating household intake of macronutrients, without displacing consumption of other foods. In contrast, production subsidies are more effective at boosting domestic supply, but also stimulate their feed use. Furthermore, subsidies drive up crop land to the detriment of pasture land and forests. The impact of these subsidies also reveals profound regional disparities, influenced by patterns of land use and of production and consumption.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】尽管人们普遍认同增加豆类生产和消费对经济、环境和健康具有积极影响，但用于种植豆类的耕地比例仍然较低，且与其他蛋白质来源（如肉类）相比，豆类在人类饮食中的占比微不足道。豆类生产和消费过程中存在外部性，这为政策干预提供了空间。在此背景下，我们利用开源且可自由访问的通用均衡计算平台（CGEBox）对全球豆类生产和消费的补贴效应进行了估算，该平台综合考虑了土地利用、土地覆盖和能源因素，并涵盖了农业和非农业家庭。分析结果提供了详细的农业食品数据，特别关注了加纳和德国这两个具有不同农业生态和社会经济条件的国家，它们都面临着多种粮食系统问题。与生产补贴相比，使用补贴更能有效降低豆类价格并促进家庭对宏量营养素的摄入，同时不会替代其他食品的消费。相比之下，生产补贴虽然能更有效地增加国内供应，但也会推动豆类作为饲料的使用。此外，补贴还会导致耕地面积增加，从而挤压牧场和森林的用地。这些补贴的影响还显示出明显的地区差异，这种差异受到土地利用模式以及生产和消费模式的影响。。研究方法：均衡模型。
